title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E21 — Home Sweet Home For The Aged
Fred is caught up in a series of frustrating situations when he becomes a resident of a senior citizens' home. Fred is put in the home by Lamont, who plans to work his way around the world on a tramp steamer and doesn't want to leave his father alone.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E22 — Pot Luck
Lamont outsmarts himself when he buys what he believes is a rare antique commode for only $20. Fred disapproves of the deal. Lamont insists that he can sell it for $400. Mr. Osborne, husband of the woman who sold the item, offers to buy it back for $200.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E23 — The Kid
Nine-year-old Jason (Lincoln Kilpatrick Jr.) worms his way into the Sanford yard and eventually into Fred's heart. Touched by the runaway's loneliness, Fred gets an idea to help others like Jason -- but he's not prepared for the results.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E19 — Piano Lesson
Robin begins to feel neglected as Mark and Vanessa develop a close friendship.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E20 — P.M.S.: Post Moving-In Syndrome
Mark and his roommates Robin and Vanessa learn how to share the responsibilities of living together. Shawn Wayans guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E21 — A Moving Experience
Mark accepts Trey's (REGGIE McFADDEN) offer to be his roommate in an apartment building filled with beautiful women and wild parties.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E22 — Livin' A Large Lie
When Mark's grandmother (MONTROSE HAGINS) visits him, he wants to impress her with his success and asks Robin and Vanessa to pose as his servants.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E1 — Baby Love
Mark's cousin, Geneva (SAUNDRA QUARTERMAN), and her daughter, Nicole (RAVEN-SYMONÉ), move into Mark and Vanessa's house.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E2 — Slumber Party
When Vanessa and Geneva get stranded in the middle of a forest due to a broken down car, Mark is forced to chaperone Nicole's slumber party by himself.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E3 — School's a Drag
Mark gets in an accident with the school's drivers' education car and fears the tough, new principal, P.J. Moore, may discharge him. Sherman Hemsley and Don Cheadle guest star.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E4 — Limpin' Lizards
Nicole gets a part on the "Lester the Lizard and Crocodile Kids" show. When Mark complains about being assigned as the drivers' education teacher, PJ reassigns him to the home economics teacher position.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E5 — Free at Last
When Vanessa is not given the promotion she was promised, she takes Mark's advice to demand her rights and is promptly discharged from her job.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E6 — Father Fairest
When Earvin tells Mark that his greatest wish is to see his long-lost father, Mark locates Earvin's dad and invites him to the Halloween dance with nearly disastrous results.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E7 — The Goodbye Girl
Mark persuades Geneva to use "reverse psychology" on the rebellious Nicole, and they let her do anything she wants to teach her that rules are important. Vanessa pretends to like sports to impress a man.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E8 — Seoul Shake
Mark learns that Earvin is prejudiced against Koreans when Mark puts a Korean boy on the basketball team.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E9 — The Prince Of Soul
When a man claiming to be an African prince proposes to Vanessa, Mark convinces her that the man is a clever thief trying to cheat them out of their home. Don Cheadle guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E10 — Air Cooper
When an advertising executive selects Mark to star in a commercial for athletic shoes, Mark misunderstands the part he is to play.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E11 — Santa's Got a Brand New Bag
Mark and Geneva are saddened when Nicole stops believing in Santa. Then a mysterious cousin visits, who knows how to make Nicole happy.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E12 — Private School
Mark is assigned to teach Black history at an expensive private school for one week. When the principal offers him a job at a much higher salary, Mark has a big decision to make.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E13 — For Whom the Heck the Bell Tolls
Not wanting to admit that he can't remember a recently deceased basketball coach, Mark agrees to give the eulogy at his funeral.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E14 — It's My Party and I'll Die If I Want to
It is almost Mark's 30th birthday, and Tyler discovers a lump on Mark. After a misunderstanding with his doctor, Mark thinks that he is dying so he goes skydiving and gives away his stuff.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E24 — Prom Fright
Mo agrees to go to another school’s prom with the son of Frank’s friend so she will no longer be busted.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E1 — Labor Day Jammy
Mo’s new school’s annual fund-raiser conflicts with Crenshaw High’s final summer blowout “Freaknik”, and Frank and Dee insist Mo should attend the fund-raiser.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E2 — (Grand)Poppa Don’t Take No Mess
Moesha tries to get sympathy from her visiting grandfather over having to go to a new school.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E3 — Day One
Mo attends the first day at her new school and is miserable.  She has only made one friend and feels out of place.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E4 — Age Ain't Nothin' But a Number
Hakeem begins to date an older woman he meets at his store.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E5 — My Mom’s Not An Ottoman
Dee wins a free decorating consultation at Mo’s school raffle and can’t wait to redo the house.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E6 — The Play Scene
Mo writes a scene from a play set in a Blues Lounge in the 1940s for her English class, and our cast acts it out for us.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E7 — Use Me Once Shame On You, Use Me Twice I’ll Kill You
Mo tells her friends at the Den that Hayley’s dad is an important record executive.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E12 — Sh-boing-boing
After an argument with his wife of 49 years, Malcolm's grandfather arrives to stay with him and Eddie.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E13 — Club Story
Eddie offers to take over at the bar so Malcolm can dine with his girlfriend's wealthy father.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E14 — Lock Down
Ticket scalping gets Malcolm and Eddie jailed on the eve of Martin Luther King Day.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E15 — Hai Karate
An unruly customer challenges Eddie to a fight; Nicolette and Holly try being roommates.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E16 — Jugglin'
While trying to help Holly, Malcolm finds himself juggling three dates at the same time.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E26 — Jenny's Thesis
Jenny Jefferson's thesis research on street gangs teaches her and her family a horrifying lesson in life...and death.
